# CRANIUM

CRANIUM is a human-first system connecting lived experience with observation, comparison and continuity.

## Core flow
Human experience → recognition → understanding → self-observation → Start → TwinMind → context/state/history/pattern → next state.

## Key concepts
- Head and neck configuration
- Cranio-cervical relationship
- C0–C1
- Primordocciput — The Primary Cranial Reference
- OBSERVE → CALIBRATE → IDENTIFY → OPTIMIZE → VERIFY
- TwinMind continuity

## Entry routes
/experience/ /how-it-works/ /head-and-neck/ /c0-c1/ /primordocciput/ /method/ /technology/ /cases/ /logbook/ /twinmind/ /your-cranium/ /start/ /explore/

## Epistemic discipline
CRANIUM separates observed, measured, reported and hypothesis-level information.
